title: Baby Sledding in Snow, 1950s Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A charming black and white snapshot from the early 1950s depicting a baby or young toddler in a snowsuit and winter cap lying prone on a small sled on a thick blanket of snow. The photo features classic deckle-edge borders typical of mid-century amateur photography. On the back, the name 'Ricky' is handwritten in blue pen alongside a stamped number '10'.
